tools.name: convert_grade
tools.description: Convert one grade between two grading systems using the real band-standing logic (Bavarian formula for inverted scales, linear fallback), via the US 4.0 baseline. Give grading-system ids to read bands from the database, or max_scale/min_pass numbers for a numeric conversion.

tools.name: get_us_equivalent
tools.description: Convert grade points on any scale to a US GPA, with letter grade and honours classification.

tools.name: gpa_to_percentage
tools.description: Convert a GPA to a percentage (0-100) on its scale.

tools.name: calculate_gpa
tools.description: Calculate a weighted GPA from courses (grade, credits, weight regular/honors/ap/ib), optionally resolved against a grading system in the database using the real band logic.

tools.name: resolve_grading_scale
tools.description: Resolve the applicable grading scale for an institution and/or country: institution override, then country profile, then global default, then a US 4.0 fallback — with confidence and an explanation.

tools.name: list_countries
tools.description: List countries with their default grading scale.

tools.name: get_country_grading_systems
tools.description: Get the grading systems for a country, with their grade mappings.

tools.name: get_grade_mappings
tools.description: Get the grade-to-GPA mapping bands for one grading system.

tools.name: search_universities
tools.description: Search institutions, grading systems and institution candidates by name.

tools.name: get_institution
tools.description: Get an institution's detail, its country, its grading override and its resolved grading scale.

tools.name: calculate_normalized_gpa
tools.description: Normalize a raw grade with the SQL calculate_normalized_gpa function (piecewise band match on a grading-system version), with a TypeScript piecewise fallback when the SQL function is unavailable.

tools.name: get_country_guide
tools.description: Assemble a country grading guide: scale table with US 4.0 equivalents, conversion tables, FAQs, common mistakes and confidence/coverage stats.
